phenomenon: The displayed saved forecast age is the time since decision.as_of. Each saved forecast uses a newly calculated feature snapshot.
compute_cadence: One serial calculation then 5 s sleep, 0.5 s market discovery
hydration: Polling after a 0.5 s sleep; query duration adds to spacing. SSE sends latest state every 0.25 s of scheduled wait or first quote wakeup.
remaining_uncertainty: The timestamp is supplied before inserting the prediction. A matched transaction commit and first browser paint were not measured for this decision.
live_model_source: The current BTC reference tick and seconds remaining update the stored feature inputs in RAM; external order book quotes are separate.
